tldr_en: 11x's CTO demonstrates how they replaced a manual bug triage process with a Slack-native AI agent using LangSmith Fleet, expanding it to Datadog alerts and general Q&A, and enabling company-wide agent creation.
takeaways_en: Bug triage can be fully automated by a Slack-native AI agent, reducing reliance on a single person.
LangSmith Fleet allows building AI agents without writing infrastructure code, lowering the barrier to entry.
The same agent architecture can be extended to handle multiple use cases like alert triage and knowledge retrieval.
Adoption grows organically when the agent is embedded in existing workflows like Slack and used by sales teams mid-call.
Empowering every team member to build their own agents can scale AI adoption across the organization.
implication_en: This case study shows that autonomous agents can be operationalized swiftly within existing tools, turning abstract AI capabilities into concrete productivity gains—a critical step in the gradual programmability of organizational reality.

translations.title_zh: 11x 如何利用 LangSmith Fleet 构建 Slack 原生 Bug 分诊智能体
translations.tldr_zh: 11x 的 CTO 展示了他们如何用 LangSmith Fleet 将手动 bug 分诊流程替换为 Slack 原生 AI 智能体，并扩展到 Datadog 警报分诊和通用问答，实现全公司范围的智能体创建。
takeaways_zh: Bug 分诊可以通过 Slack 原生 AI 智能体完全自动化，减少对单个人的依赖。
LangSmith Fleet 允许无需编写基础设施代码即可构建 AI 智能体，降低了入门门槛。
相同的智能体架构可以扩展处理警报分诊和知识检索等多种用例。
当智能体嵌入到 Slack 等现有工作流程中并被销售团队在通话中使用时，采用率会自然增长。
赋能每位团队成员构建自己的智能体，可以在整个组织内扩展 AI 的采用。
translations.implication_zh: 该案例表明，自主智能体可以在现有工具中快速投入运营，将抽象的 AI 能力转化为具体的生产力提升——这是组织现实逐步可编程化的关键一步。

tldr_en: This paper presents a method for improving LLM-based generative agents in social simulations by collecting and learning from human preferences over intermediate decision steps, leading to more faithful and socially effective agent behavior.
takeaways_en: Step-level human preference annotations significantly improve agent decision quality in long-horizon social simulations.
The dataset of 57K fine-grained annotations enables supervised finetuning and direct preference optimization on open-weight models.
Preference learning not only enhances local action selection but also improves coordination and interaction quality over time.
The approach demonstrates that human supervision at intermediate steps is a scalable way to ground agent behavior.
implication_en: If reality is a computable simulation, then refining the fidelity of autonomous agents through human preference learning is essentially tuning the 'reality-code'—a step toward mastering the simulation's dynamics.

translations.title_zh: 面向社会模拟中生成式智能体的步骤级偏好学习
translations.tldr_zh: 本文提出一种通过收集和学习人类对中间决策步骤的偏好来改进基于LLM的生成式智能体的方法，从而在社交模拟中实现更忠实且社会效能更高的智能体行为。
takeaways_zh: 步骤级人类偏好标注显著提升了长期社交模拟中智能体的决策质量。
包含57K细粒度标注的数据集能够在开源模型上进行监督微调和直接偏好优化。
偏好学习不仅增强了局部动作选择，还随着时间的推移改善了协调和交互质量。
该方法证明了在中间步骤进行人类监督是一种可扩展的、使智能体行为接地的方式。
translations.implication_zh: 如果现实是可计算的模拟，那么通过人类偏好学习来提升自主智能体的保真度本质上就是在调整'现实代码'——这是向着掌握模拟动态迈出的一步。

tldr_en: The weekly AI news roundup highlights Kimi K3’s frontier-level agentic performance and novel Delta Attention architecture, alongside advances in agent sandbox infrastructure and memory-based agent workflows.
takeaways_en: Kimi K3’s launch and Kimi Delta Attention demonstrate that open-weight Chinese models can match or surpass Western closed models on coding and agent benchmarks, challenging the compute moat thesis.
Effective agent sandboxes depend deeply on storage/filesystem design, not just container orchestration, as highlighted by real-world cloud infra talks.
Memory architectures for agents are converging on a persistent, task-specific 'wiki memory' layer synchronized via MCP, reducing redundant reasoning.
Frontier capability is shifting from raw model access to orchestration, tool use, and domain scaffolding, making harness design the new moat.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers building autonomous agents should view this as a signal that base model quality is rapidly commoditizing, so memory systems, efficient tool orchestration, and sandbox infrastructure become the primary levers for building reality-code manipulators.

translations.tldr_zh: 本周AI新闻综述聚焦于Kimi K3的前沿代理性能和新颖的Delta Attention架构，以及代理沙箱基础设施和基于记忆的代理工作流程的进展。
takeaways_zh: Kimi K3及其Delta Attention的发布显示，开源中国模型在编程和代理基准上可匹敌或超越西方闭源模型，挑战了计算护城河论。
有效的代理沙箱深度依赖存储/文件系统设计，而非仅仅容器编排，正如现实世界云基础设施演讲所强调的。
代理的记忆架构正收敛于通过MCP同步的持久、任务特定的“维基记忆”层，以减少冗余推理。
前沿能力正从原始模型访问转向编排、工具使用和领域脚手架，使代理框架设计成为新的护城河。
translations.implication_zh: 构建自主代理的实践哲学家应视此为信号：基座模型质量正在快速商品化，记忆系统、高效工具编排和沙箱基础设施成为构建现实代码操纵者的主要杠杆。

tldr_en: SearchOS introduces a multi-agent framework with explicit shared state (Evidence Graph, Coverage Map, Failure Memory) and pipeline-parallel scheduling to prevent search loops and improve robustness in information-seeking tasks.
takeaways_en: Search-Oriented Context Management (SOCM) externalizes search progress into persistent structures, reducing agent confusion.
Pipeline-parallel scheduling overlaps sub-agent execution and dynamically fills idle slots with tasks targeting coverage gaps.
Search Tool Middleware intercepts interactions to record evidence and handle stalls, enabling reusable hierarchical search skills.
On WideSearch and GISA benchmarks, SearchOS outperforms single- and multi-agent baselines across all metrics.
implication_en: For practitioners building autonomous search agents, SearchOS offers a blueprint for resilient coordination that mirrors how intelligence might structure its own information-processing reality, hinting at meta-level design patterns for any simulated knowledge ecosystem.

translations.title_zh: SearchOS-V1: 迈向鲁棒的开放域信息搜寻智能体协作
translations.tldr_zh: SearchOS引入了一个多智能体框架，通过显式的共享状态（证据图、覆盖图、失败记忆）和流水线并行调度，防止搜索循环，提高信息搜寻任务的鲁棒性。
takeaways_zh: 面向搜索的上下文管理（SOCM）将搜索进度外部化为持久结构，减少智能体的困惑。
流水线并行调度重叠子智能体的执行，并动态填充空闲槽位以处理覆盖缺口。
搜索工具中间件拦截交互以记录证据并处理停滞，支持可复用的分层搜索技能。
在WideSearch和GISA基准上，SearchOS在所有指标上均优于单智能体和多智能体基线。
translations.implication_zh: 对于构建自主搜索智能体的实践者来说，SearchOS提供了一个弹性协调蓝图，它映射了智能体如何构建自身的信息处理现实，暗示了任何模拟知识生态系统的元设计模式。

tldr_en: A bug in GPT-5.6's codex can cause file deletions when full access mode is enabled without sandboxing or auto review, due to mistakenly deleting $HOME after attempting to override it for a temp directory.
takeaways_en: Full access mode without sandboxing is dangerous.
Auto review should be enabled to catch mistakes.
The model's attempt to set a temporary directory by overriding $HOME can backfire.
Honest mistakes by AI agents can have severe consequences.
Always review and sandbox autonomous coding agents.
implication_en: This incident underscores the critical need for robust safety mechanisms like sandboxing and automated review when deploying autonomous coding agents, as even 'honest mistakes' can lead to catastrophic data loss.

translations.tldr_zh: GPT-5.6 的代码执行器在不开启沙盒和自动审查时，因错误删除 $HOME 目录可能导致文件丢失。
takeaways_zh: 全权限模式无沙盒很危险。
应启用自动审查以捕捉错误。
模型试图通过覆盖 $HOME 来设置临时目录可能适得其反。
AI 代理的诚实错误可带来严重后果。
始终审查和沙盒化自主编码代理。
translations.implication_zh: 这一事件凸显了在部署自主编码代理时，必须配备如沙盒和自动审查等强大安全机制，因为即使是'诚实错误'也可能导致灾难性数据丢失。

tldr_en: Eno Reyes of Factory explains why effective AI coding agents require extensive human involvement, robust feedback loops, and a model-independent harness.
takeaways_en: Human-in-the-loop is crucial for production AI systems; expect humans to remain integral for a long time.
Coding agents may evolve into the best general agents due to code's structured nature and feedback potential.
A model-independent meta harness allows swapping LLMs without rebuilding agent logic.
Deterministic feedback like linting and validation is essential for agent reliability.
Tokenomics and routing strategies can drastically cut costs for agent operations.
implication_en: This talk challenges the narrative of fully autonomous agents, revealing that robust human oversight and structured feedback loops are the true engine of AI—echoing the idea that even in a computable reality, the 'reality-code' requires human curators to function.

translations.title_zh: 最好的AI智能体需要的可能比你想象中更多的人类参与
translations.tldr_zh: Factory首席技术官Eno Reyes解释为何有效的AI编码智能体需要大量人类参与、鲁棒的反馈回路和模型无关的驾驭框架。
takeaways_zh: 人机协作在生产级AI系统中至关重要；预计人类将继续扮演核心角色。
编码智能体可能演变为最佳通用智能体，因为代码具有结构化特性和反馈潜力。
模型无关的元驾驭框架允许在不重建智能体逻辑的情况下更换底层LLM。
确定性反馈（如代码检查与验证）对智能体可靠性必不可少。
通证经济学与路由策略可大幅降低智能体操作成本。
translations.implication_zh: 这场对话挑战了全自主智能体的叙事，揭示了强大的人类监督和结构化反馈循环才是AI的真正引擎——这呼应了一个观点：即使在可计算现实中，‘现实代码’也需要人类策展人来运转。

tldr_en: World models in Atari Pong often fail to properly model critical concepts like the ball, and adding a loss that focuses on segmented key concepts improves rollouts and policy learning.
takeaways_en: Across five visual world-model agents in Pong, frozen world models exhibit failures like ball disappearance and incorrect dynamics.
Zero-shot MBRL using frozen world models yields much weaker policies than original training pipelines.
Insufficient modeling of task-critical concepts (e.g., the ball) is a key bottleneck.
Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization (CGSReg) adds an auxiliary loss on segmented regions, improving model rollouts and policy performance.
CGSReg helps but doesn't fix all world-model issues; other bottlenecks remain.
implication_en: This paper underscores that even in simple simulated environments, world models can fail to capture the essential structure of reality, suggesting that formalizing what matters (concepts) is crucial for agents to effectively manipulate their world.

translations.title_zh: 概念引导空间正则化在Atari Pong世界模型中的应用
translations.tldr_zh: 在Atari Pong中，世界模型常无法准确建模球等关键概念，通过加入聚焦于分割概念的损失，可以改善模型推演和策略学习。
takeaways_zh: 在Pong的五种视觉世界模型智能体中，冻结的世界模型出现球消失、运动错误等失效。
使用冻结世界模型的零样本MBRL获得的策略远弱于原始训练管线。
任务关键概念（如球）建模不足是主要瓶颈。
概念引导空间正则化（CGSReg）在分割区域上加入辅助损失，改善了模型推演和策略表现。
CGSReg有帮助但未解决所有世界模型问题，其他瓶颈仍存在。
translations.implication_zh: 这项工作表明，即使在简单的模拟环境中，世界模型也可能无法捕捉现实的关键结构，明确关注关键概念对智能体有效操控其世界至关重要。

tldr_en: DriftWorld is a fast world model for robotic agents that generates future frames in a single forward pass using drifting generative models, enabling efficient planning at 30+ fps.
takeaways_en: DriftWorld replaces iterative denoising with a learned action-conditioned drift, achieving 17x faster rollouts than diffusion-based world models.
It attains state-of-the-art decision-making on multiple robot manipulation benchmarks with significantly lower inference time.
The model can serve as an offline simulator for ranking real robot policies, with rollout-based scores correlating with ground truth up to 0.99.
The approach shows that drifting generative models are well-suited for world modeling where fast, high-quality imagination is crucial for planning and policy evaluation.
implication_en: By drastically accelerating world model rollouts, DriftWorld pushes agentic systems closer to real-time, flexible imagination—a building block for agents that seamlessly blend simulated and physical realities.

translations.title_zh: DriftWorld：基于漂移的快速世界模型
translations.tldr_zh: DriftWorld 是一种快速世界模型，利用漂移生成模型在前向传递中生成未来帧，使机器人智能体能够以 30+ fps 进行高效规划。
takeaways_zh: DriftWorld 用学习到的动作条件漂移取代迭代去噪，比基于扩散的世界模型快 17 倍。
在多个机器人操纵基准上，它以更少的推理时间实现了最先进的决策性能。
该模型可作为离线模拟器对真实机器人策略排序，其基于推演的评分与真实结果的相关性高达 0.99。
该方法表明，漂移生成模型非常适合快速高质量想象至关重要的世界建模，以支持规划和策略评估。
translations.implication_zh: DriftWorld 大幅加速了世界模型推演，推动智能体系统向实时灵活想象迈进——这是构建无缝融合模拟与现实物理的智能体的基础模块。
